title: Ad Production Blueprint
purpose: Give the production team a feasible route, a proof beat and a clear acceptance check.
disclosure: FICTIONAL WORKED EXAMPLE. All products, feedback and constraints here are synthetic. No campaign has run and no performance result is claimed.

sources.label: Fictional product brief
sources.text: A fictional approval tool shows an assigned owner and a timestamped decision trail. No measured turnaround improvement, integrations or compliance certification is supplied.

sources.label: Positive feedback
sources.text: The owner field made it clear who needed to reply.

sources.label: Mixed feedback
sources.text: I could find the owner, but our approvals still waited on legal review.

sources.label: Unresolved buyer question
sources.text: Can an external reviewer open it without creating an account?

sources.label: Production inventory
sources.text: A local demo workspace and a screen recorder are available. External access is unverified. No customer logos or real customer records may be shown.

cards.title: One feature, one continuous proof
cards.decision: A 15-second review cut built from the available product or demo workspace.

fields.Viewer takeaway: See who owns the next decision.
fields.Beat schedule: 0-3s: orient the viewer. 3-10s: demonstrate the feature. 10-15s: show the product-detail next step. Total: 15s.
fields.Asset inventory: A local demo workspace and a screen recorder are available. External access is unverified. No customer logos or real customer records may be shown. Demonstration footage is planned, not captured.
fields.Acceptance check: Feature remains visible; wording stays within P1; captions work muted; no identifiable customer data.
fields.Fallback: A labeled still-image animatic for review if recording is unavailable.

cards.next: Capture the demonstration; Ready applies to the plan, not to finished media.

cards.title: Do not stage a customer endorsement
cards.decision: A testimonial route is not supported by the current assets.

fields.Viewer takeaway: Would imply a real customer experience if presented as testimony.
fields.Beat schedule: Not scheduled; no authorized performance or script.
fields.Asset inventory: No licensed testimonial recording or approved customer quotation supplied.
fields.Acceptance check: Do not turn synthetic feedback into a real testimonial.
fields.Fallback: Use the direct product demonstration without a customer persona.

cards.next: Remove the testimonial route or obtain an authorized real account and review its exact claim.

cards.title: Capture the missing compatibility check

fields.Viewer takeaway: Show a verified capability only after testing it.
fields.Execution route: A short inspection insert, conditional on a successful check.
fields.Beat schedule: Proposed 5-second insert replaces part of the 3-10s beat; total stays 15s.
fields.Asset inventory: Can an external reviewer open it without creating an account?
fields.Acceptance check: Document the actual outcome; a failure must change the script.
fields.Fallback: Omit the compatibility claim and retain the narrower feature story.

cards.next: Resolve the buyer question before writing the insert as a fact.
